newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 2nd 1-wk rev repo at max 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 2nd 1-wk rev repo at max 45 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Monday it would hold a one-week reverse repo tender to drain liquidity from the market -- its second of the day -- at a maximum rate of 45 percent, unchanged from the previous rate.
The CNB said in a statement that the tender maturity would be from June 4-11.
The CNB said it would accept two bids from participants of a minimum 100 million crowns until 10.10 a.m. (0810 GMT).
At the first tender earlier on Tuesday, average yield hit 44.43 percent, down from 45 percent in a similar tender on Monday, and lower than last week's rate of 75 percent.
